highlights: Ignifire now opens with a dedicated animated startup splash screen.
The desktop window remains hidden until the saved library, preferences, and first view are ready.
A smooth crossfade transitions from the Ignifire loading experience into the main app.
Startup includes a recovery timeout so an initialization problem can never leave the app invisible.
notes: Adds a polished animated Ignifire startup splash that stays visible until the renderer finishes loading durable state and its initial library view.
